mapper.select: select id from collect_interface_config where enabled = 1 and is_deleted = 0 and task_id = ( select current_task.task_id from ( select task_id, task_status from experiment_task order by event_time desc, update_time desc limit 1 ) current_task where current_task.task_status = 1 ) order by id
select id, interface_name from collect_interface_config where enabled = 1 and is_deleted = 0 order by id

mapper.select:
select
from collect_interface_config where is_deleted = 0
and task_id = #{taskId}
order by id
select count(1) from collect_interface_config where is_deleted = 0

select count(1) as interface_total, coalesce(sum(case when enabled = 1 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as online_total, coalesce( ( select sum(statistics.collection_count) from collect_interface_statistics statistics where statistics.statistics_time >= current_date and statistics.is_deleted = 0 and statistics.task_id = #{taskId} ), 0 ) as today_collection_count from collect_interface_config where is_deleted = 0 and task_id = #{taskId}

select ,
( select protocol_config.config_name from collect_protocol_config protocol_config where protocol_config.id = collect_interface_config.protocol_config_id and protocol_config.is_deleted = 0 ) as protocol_config_name from collect_interface_config where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0

select coalesce(nullif(trim(interface_name), ''), concat('未命名采集接口（编号：', cast(id as varchar), '）')) from collect_interface_config where protocol_config_id = #{protocolConfigId} and is_deleted = 0 order by id

mapper.update: update collect_interface_config set task_id = #{taskId}, interface_name = #{interfaceName}, interface_type = #{interfaceType}, send_from = #{sendFrom}, message_content = #{messageContent}, transfer_type = #{transferType}, transfer_protocol = #{transferProtocol}, protocol_config_id = #{protocolConfigId}, host = #{host}, port = #{port}, multicast_ip = #{multicastIp}, status = #{status}, enabled = #{enabled}, rpc_enabled = #{rpcEnabled}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
update collect_interface_config set is_deleted = 1, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
